scope: Add direct AC1024 ASCII/Binary allocation-failure coverage for the profiled dynamic-block BasePointParameter writer, including source identity rollback and fresh-writer retry/readback.

change.testCoverage: Extended the generated dynamic-block allocation target with the bounded BasePointParameter profile used by the existing adapter writer control. The injected sweep covers every allocation made by direct writeDynamicBlockObject calls.
change.perEncoding: ASCII exercises 14 allocation offsets and Binary exercises 12. Each failure preserves caller fields and leaves no sourceHandleToWrittenObjectMap entry. The same source then succeeds through a fresh writer. Clean wire readback checks record and owner handles, node id, base-point subclass, parameter scalar, and defining/point/base-point coordinates.
change.existingAdapterControl: The existing dwg2dxf_dynamic_block_basepoint_parameter_writer control checks exact emitted group order, typed readback, invalid-coordinate destination preservation, corrected same-writer retry, and unknown-tail raw-only handling.

limitations: Fault injection is at the low-level record writer; it does not establish whole-file destination rollback under allocation failure.
A fresh writer is used after each failure because the failed writer may contain partial bytes and has a sticky write error.
This covers only the bounded BasePointParameter candidate. Other dynamic-block schemas, graph closure, producer breadth, and native semantics remain separate gates.
The test authors an in-memory record; no fixture is added and no support claim is promoted.
nextReadyPacket: Continue the P6 transaction and no-loss audit for another concrete uncovered writer/profile; preserve the format, graph, and native-consumer gates.
